offering_description.value: Designs and sells IoT connectivity hardware, embedded modules and device management software to businesses, OEMs and utilities. Products are built in-house and sold through distributors, partners and direct sales, with cloud services for remote management.

primary_products.value: cellular routers; console servers; embedded wireless modules; industrial gateways; IoT device management software

primary_services.value: cloud device management; professional services; technical support subscriptions

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs, system integrators, utilities, retailers, transportation and healthcare operators; B2G: public utilities and municipal infrastructure operators

end_markets.value: industrial IoT; utilities; transportation; retail; healthcare; energy

revenue_model.value: product sales: routers, gateways, modules and console servers sold to businesses; subscription: cloud device management and remote monitoring software subscriptions; service fees: professional services, installation support and technical support contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds connectivity hardware from purchased components, sold to businesses; software / platform: provides cloud device management software to connected device fleets

geography_served.value: global: sells worldwide, with major operations in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: cellular routers, console servers, embedded modules and IoT cloud software

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: global electronics and industrial distributors stocking connectivity products; partners / resellers: system integrators and value-added resellers deploying IoT solutions; direct sales: direct sales teams serving large enterprise and OEM accounts; online: online store selling hardware and software subscriptions directly
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: radio certification such as FCC approval for wireless devices, plus product security and export control rules
